text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas.
Everyone spends it in their own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those who throw extravagant parties.
Those who celebrate quietly. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Sizzleeeeee!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, don't grill the meat just yet.
First comes the toast, after all."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, do you have your glasses?
Alright then, ready, set...!"

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainees
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the boxing gym that is Wonder Acute's family home. Borrowing the convenience store parking lot next door—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that a Christmas yakiniku party
would be held together with the trainees.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Has anyone run out of drinks?
Once it's empty, let me pour some more for you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Listen, okay? You shouldn't eat meat raw. And another thing...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 1
text_block_list.text:
Young lady, stop fretting over everyone else
and enjoy yourself for once.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 2
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly, because this Christmas party is also a celebration of young lady's accomplishments.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Even if you tell me that, I don't really know what to say.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 1
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer-san! Thank you as always
for giving our young lady such sharp, top-notch guidance!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 2
text_block_list.text:
Your work as her second at the racetrack was amazing, too.
You really know how to fire the young lady up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san doesn't even realize.
Just how well they're actually doing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we were talking about that, the dry thud of mitts echoed from the gym next door.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap-clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are there girls practicing
without eating?

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah, those whose real races are coming up are cutting weight right now.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 1
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is working hard.
Determined not to lose to the young lady."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Good girl, how admirable.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Even if food is out of the question, at least some drinks... Let's see, glasses, glasses... Where are the glasses...?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Grass-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hello, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised.
This Umamusume is Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A returnee from America and a traditional Yamato Nadeshiko...
or rather, an Umamusume with a warrior's heart.
Why is she in a place like this...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did the smell of meat draw them in?
In that case~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't need food.
Instead―

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap-clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall take this sound. How wonderful...
The sound of a thirsting fighting spirit. Now this is true elegance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I don't quite understand the sentiment of mitt sounds being "elegant." But Grass Wonder surely has her own distinct aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what could explain this difference in sound...? 
Could there really be so many kinds of boxing trainees?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The resonance is completely different.
From youthful tones to a truly seasoned sound.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true... From girls who are about to debut
to seasoned veterans, there are all sorts here~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Someone right on the verge of retirement just ain't got
that kinda energy left...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The fierce vigor of young sprouts bursting forth is good too.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A fallen leaf resisting decay, dreaming
once more of the days it was lush and green... It has its own charm, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Even if the sound is faint,
I sense no sign of giving up in it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The simple, single-minded will to strive for victory.
I can feel it... strongly... so strongly...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is—a lovely place. Just standing here
makes me feel as though I am being washed pure and clean...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Here... lie the waka poems of those who fight.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 1
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! You really get it, Grass Wonder-san!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee 2
text_block_list.text:
Here, please, gulp down a glass of juice!
Make yourself right at home!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my~, thank you so much for the thought ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Still, is it really all right for me to join in, Acute-san?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... A sweet girl like
Grass-chan is always more than welcome, of course.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to drop by anytime.
Think of it as fate bringing us together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much.
I have taken a great liking to this place, truly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A waka poem of warriors. Not merely defying fate, but dreaming of the day they bloom once more...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those words... felt like a deeply meaningful
Christmas present.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Let's keep giving it our all. We're not done yet.
...Let's keep giving it our all. We've still got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
That's true, you're quite right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Jingle, jingle, jingle...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Christmas blessing.
It is not meant for lovers alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of those who do not give up on tomorrow,
it rings out equally..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of those who do not give up on tomorrow,
it rings out equally..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And that night, while we were walking together through the Christmas illuminations..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Fancy places like this really don't sit well with me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My eyes are flickering a bit, or rather...
Oh, what's that...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, at about that level,
even if it's pretty, it's not too flashy or blinding.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Here, silverwork. Take a look, take a look...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closer... cute silver crafts were being sold
under the storefront eaves. There were Christmas wreath shapes,
stocking shapes, and more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They were all reasonably priced and cute to boot.
From among them, I picked out one that Wonder Acute might like—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear me... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An impromptu Christmas present.
When I apologized for it being so modest...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: What are you even saying? As for me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"It's the thought that counts, you know.
The sentiment behind giving it."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, this will be a precious memento of today~.
I'm sure every time I look at it, I'll remember today...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... That's wonderful.
To have something that becomes a memento...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A memento for an important day... A keepsake of memories...
Hearing that, an idea suddenly came to mind."
choice_data_list: Should I give you one every time you win a big race?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Wait, give silverware as a gift?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because it'll become a fond memory.
Yeah, because it'll become a fond memory.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You really are such a sweet girl~.
Yes... yes, if it's not too much trouble...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If we can get something so wonderful,
we'll just have to work harder and collect lots of them, won't we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute was overjoyed by the small promise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, every time Wonder Acute wins,
her silver collection will only keep growing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two of them pledged that, in time, they would build a grand collection of wonderful memories together.
